title: Quick-Fix Crispy Peruvian Potato Papa Rellena
description: A smoky, crunchy, and quick-fix Peruvian dish featuring tamarind paste and coconut cream. Perfect for a weeknight meal.

ingredients.name: Tamarind paste
ingredients.notes: available at most Asian or Middle Eastern markets.

instructions: Boil the potatoes until tender, about 10 minutes.
Drain the potatoes and mash them in a bowl.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and garlic to the skillet and saut5 until the onion is translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add the cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper to the skillet and stir for 1 minute.
Stir in the tamarind paste, coconut cream, and mashed potatoes.
Heat the mixture over low heat, stirring constantly, until the potatoes have absorbed most of the liquid and the mixture is thick and creamy, about 5 minutes.
Transfer the mixture to a shallow dish and let it cool to room temperature.
Using your hands, shape the cooled mixture into 8-10 small oval shapes.
Dip each potato shape into the beaten egg and then roll it in the makham and chopped cilantro to coat.
Heat about 1/2 inch of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Fry the coated potatoes until crispy and golden brown, about 3-4 minutes on each side.
Drain the potatoes on paper towels and serve immediately.
